notes.title: Wanderlust: TMJ Demo 2.1 release
notes.notes: [p]Taking NextFest feedback into account, we've made several changes to the Wanderlust demo.[/p][list][*][p]Shortened the length of the prologue section so characters are introduced quicker.[/p][/*][*][p]Removed unnecessary lines of text throughout all three chapters, that allows for better story flow.[/p][/*][*][p]"Voice" volume is now tied with the vocal beeps, and can be muted if the player wishes.[/p][/*][*][p]New name input screen to help avoid confusing/mismatch pronoun usage.[/p][/*][*][p]Removed ending screen and replaced it with simple text prompts[/p][/*][/list]
